name: command-guard
description: Destructive-command prevention: a PreToolUse hook that classifies every Bash (and MCP shell/SQL) command before it runs — denying irreversible data loss (migrate:fresh, DROP DATABASE, rm -rf /, docker compose down -v, terraform destroy, cloud deletes, overwriting a live .env, a cd into a missing dir) and prompting on scoped-but-destructive ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf on a path git cannot restore, kubectl delete pod). Reads through quotes, wrappers and heredocs; skips read-only commands; fail-open. A second PreToolUse config-guard asks before a write weakens settings, hooks, manifests or lint/test config. Ships /command-guard:check and a user-owned allow-file the agent cannot edit.

cc_config_guard.title: Config guard (CC_CONFIG_GUARD)
cc_config_guard.description: Ask before a write that would weaken settings, hooks, manifests or lint and test config: on or off. The environment variable CC_CONFIG_GUARD overrides this.

claude_destructive_guard.title: Destructive-command guard mode (CLAUDE_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD)
claude_destructive_guard.description: Destructive-command guard: deny (hard stops plus asks), ask (prompt instead), deny-only or off. The environment variable CLAUDE_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD overrides this.
